releases.name: S.E.X. Project: Simulated Emotional Xenotech
releases.summary:
Step into the world of the S.E.X. Project, an experimental program in which multiple androids explore the boundaries of emotion, desire, and connection. Each synthetic companion has a unique personality, story, and path to uncover. Some seek love, some crave freedom, and some may hide dangerous secrets. Your choices will define their evolution and your fate.
Will you fall for them, help them, or lose yourself in simulated affection?

Key Features:
• Meet and interact with multiple android heroines, each with a unique design, traits, and branching storylines.
• Navigate romantic, dramatic, and suspenseful storylines by making impactful decisions.
• A blend of visual novel intimacy and sci-fi adventure.
• An immersive, futuristic world inspired by cyberpunk romance and emotional AI testing.

releases.name: Novalex Project Zero
releases.summary: Build a car empire from a single garage. Design every model from the chassis up, run the factories, price sharp, and outsell 30 AI rivals — a turn-based automaker tycoon spanning decades. Out-engineer the competition or go bankrupt trying.

releases.name: Von Neumann Project
releases.summary: Von Neumann Project is about a self replicating probe as it charts the galaxies, peacefully of course. Mine, build, expand, and explore in this sci-fi RTS. Remember to have as little impact on your surroundings as possible and protect yourself at all costs.

releases.name: Desktop Fireworks Festival
releases.summary: Desktop Fireworks Festival is a management game where your desktop becomes the venue for your very own fireworks festival. Grow your festival into a grand venue and fill your desktop sky with a spectacular fireworks display of your own!

releases.name: Vilnius Museum of Antiquities: A Temple of the Past
releases.summary: A virtual exhibition recreating the first public museum in Lithuania—the Vilnius Museum of Antiquities. Open the doors to the mid-19th century, discover over 100 unique historical exhibits, talk to the founder of the museum himself, and learn about the fate of the collection.

releases.name: 100 Hidden Relics
releases.summary: Find 100 hidden relics as a renegade knight. Explore a small town and its surrounding lands in this short dark fantasy hidden-object game.

releases.name: DeepCorp Rescue
releases.summary: DeepCorp Rescue is a physics-based arcade rescue game where you pilot a fragile rocket through dangerous caves, dodge traps, save workers, recover cargo, and land safely. Upgrade your ship, master tricky missions, and survive DeepCorp’s hazardous underground world.

releases.name: Sort Them Fish
releases.summary: Sort Them Fish is a cozy organizing simulator where you return 2538 fish to their proper aquariums in a cluttered aquatics store. Fill the tanks, learn abilities and turn the chaos into a beautifully organized fish collection.

releases.name: Cat Caffeine
releases.summary: A cozy idle ASMR cat café that lives on your screen. Serve customers and decorate your café while you work or relax.

releases.name: Chivalware
releases.summary: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

releases.name: Retail Nation: My Supermarket
releases.summary: Build, customize and manage your own supermarket in this first-person retail simulation. Order stock, fill shelves, serve customers, manage and develop employees, and grow a small shop into a thriving supermarket.

releases.name: Not My Son
releases.summary: A psychological horror game where a stepfather is left alone with a disturbing child. Explore a quiet house, face growing nightmares, and piece together the truth behind the boy’s behavior.

releases.name: Lil Laundry Lane
releases.summary: Run a hand-painted little laundromat that's all yours. Take in orders from the neighborhood's regulars, tend each load with care, and sink into the soothing rhythm of cleaning clothes.

releases.name: 1daYs
releases.summary: 1daYs is a 2D narrative adventure game where everyday life and small mysteries intertwine.

releases.name: Green Gas
releases.summary: 3–5 Cells. One hidden Cancer.???? Which one will you become????? Work together to gather money and power the main Generator to survive But the Cancer hides among you, stealing cash, spreading toxic gas or water setting deadly traps and contaminating rooms Trapped? Win the mini‑game or die!

releases.name: Unpredictable Cake
releases.summary: A village of farmers is in trouble... A rageful and salty wizard, a huge rotten cake and a mouse as hero? Yes, you'll find all of these inside Unpredictable Cake, a 3D platform game where the main character is a mouse and the other characters are even more strange.

releases.name: Artificial Ambition
releases.summary: Grow your AI startup from a 2017 garage to an industry titan. Hire specialists, train models, and outsmart rivals. Build the future, but tread carefully—your relentless drive for progress might just open a Pandora's box of unintended power.

releases.name: The Usual Table: Texas Hold'em
releases.summary: A relaxing single-player six-max No-Limit Texas Hold’em game. Sit down with five AI opponents, each with their own playing style, and enjoy the simple pleasure of betting, reading the table, and making the right call at your own pace.

releases.name: Neuville Survivors
releases.summary: Play a Survival game that combines Exploration and Tower Defense, and discover why on Neuville, the AI does not want humans on the planet.

releases.name: Airframe Ultra
releases.summary: From the cracked asphalt of San Juaro and the Ysidro edgelands to the hulking megacities of the Texicali ZEGO zone, Airframe riders from all across the Southlands compete for fame, fortune, and a chance at glory... three feet above or six feet below.

releases.name: JapaneseDialect
releases.summary: Japanese Dialects: Words You'll Want to Use

releases.name: Magic Ball Sort
releases.summary: Sort glowing elemental orbs in magical containers, solve hundreds of relaxing puzzles, and master an undefeated archmage's challenges. A premium puzzle game with no ads, energy, or microtransactions.

releases.name: Nie Xiaoqian
releases.summary: Nie Xiaoqian is a supernatural visual novel set in ancient China. At a ruined temple in Jinhua, scholar Ning Caichen meets a trapped young ghost. Grow closer through doubt, trust and mortal danger. Shape their story with key choices, explore different endings, and find where they belong.

releases.name: Enkhbayar's Olympiad Chess: Multi-Board Team Matches
releases.summary: Olympiad Chess evolves classical chess into a unified 4v4 team sport. Across shared middle ranks, pieces migrate between boards to flank opponents and save teammates. A true multi-board competitive variant built to completely revolutionize the team chess format!

releases.name: LINE WARLORD
releases.summary: A real-time line-battle roguelite. Spend rations to summon swordsmen, shields, archers and cavalry onto a single front, then break the enemy base. Pick relics and promotions at every fork to build a different army each run. Three commanders, three ultimates.

releases.name: Diamonds and Spades
releases.summary: At first glance, Diamonds and Spades looks like a simple card game. But then you discover powerful combos and achieve absurdly high scores. Collect unique Tarot cards with special abilities and create your own cards in the editor.

releases.name: Build the Hole
releases.summary: Build the course, sabotage your friends and be the first to putt the ball! Go fast to be first, or play it smart and rack up points by taking fewer shots. Place obstacles, traps and use powerups to sabotage them. But remember, they might also be plotting to sabotage you.

releases.name: Type Me Home
releases.summary: Type in commands with your keyboard to guide a lost baby lizard through wild platforming challenges and reunite it with its mama.

releases.name: BONEYARD BOUNCE!
releases.summary: All four edges of the board are your paddle — a block breaker unfolded in four directions. Fire a spell-ball into a monster-packed graveyard maze and watch it carom through the horde. Elemental kills chain-detonate straight through walls. Smash the headstones too; the landlord pays for wreckage.

releases.name: HIJURA SCARLET GEAR
releases.summary: A chaotic, mad run-and-gun! Flamethrowers, homing, double jumps, invincible dashes—all here! As Hijura with a Scarlet Gear, destroy the "Dokugan" horde! 35-year dev Zorge Ichizo's "AI-Toxic" showdown with AI. Will I dance to the AI's tune, or will my individuality win? See for yourself!

releases.name: Coverage
releases.summary: A board game for two players similar to games like Othello and Ataxx. Cover the board with your pieces--or take over all of your opponent's.

releases.name: Card Slay
releases.summary: The poker roguelike where the House fights back. Chase the flush, sweat the last discard, then slam it down and watch the damage hit: red suits strike, black suits shield. The monsters read your hand, call your ranks and cheat, so stack your ritual deck, out-cheat them, and slay your fate.

releases.name: Psychotrons
releases.summary: Psychotrons is a point and click in the wake of Monkey Island, there is no game over. 90+ challenges/screens where the player collects Lost Neurons and convinces the Psychotrons to give up them engaging in absurd conversation. There is no graphic violence and it is a full OFF-LINE game.

releases.name: Captive 3000
releases.summary: Old-school sci-fi first-person real-time dungeon crawler. Grid-based movement. Traditional sprite design. Inspired by classic 'blobber' games like Dungeon Master, Eye of the Beholder, and the Amiga/Atari masterpiece Captive.

releases.name: Moon Swarm
releases.summary: Defend your moon from endless alien waves! Collect gold, upgrade defenses, unlock new weapons and planets, and build the perfect defense while you do other things.

releases.name: Apple Catcher
releases.summary: Use your webcam to control the action in Apple Catcher, a colorful motion-controlled arcade game. Lean left and right to move your basket, catch apples, avoid sticks, clear increasingly challenging levels, and chase a high score in Endless Mode.

releases.name: Junkyard Reseller
releases.summary: Choose an AWESOME BLOCK MAN and race your way through the streets!! Be careful you don't crash into the Harlem Shakers, SCARY zombies, stick men and the ninjas....!!!!!!!!

releases.name: Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard
releases.summary: The dragon's hoard has gotten out of hand. Sit back, sweep up mountains of gold coin by coin, fill chest after chest, and give every buried treasure its rightful place on the shelves. Watch chaos turn into order, piece by piece. A cozy organizing game. There are cats.

releases.name: Maria IV: A Cozy Botanical Sim
releases.summary: Grow, nurture and sell exquisite flowers from your own shop in old France. Plant seeds, tend each bloom with care, master dozens of species, and build a thriving florist as customers come seeking the perfect bouquet — all in first person, at your own peaceful pace.

releases.name: Shove Nova
releases.summary: Shove Nova is a fast-paced 2D physics arena game where you grow your energy sphere, use powerful abilities, and smash rivals out of a shrinking battlefield. Master chaotic arenas filled with portals, black holes, bounce walls, and other hazards as you fight to be the last one standing.

releases.name: Mugen Kaidan: Danchi
releases.summary: A first-person psychological horror game set in an apartment stairwell looping from the 2nd to the 10th floor. Notice changes in doors, windows, and sounds, uncover the code, and find a way to the rooftop.

releases.name: RailBlaster
releases.summary: Ride twisting rails through ten worlds that pulse with the music, blasting everything in sight. Build combos, slow time, outsmart ghosts, blinkers and walls, and face two bosses. Play on a monitor or in VR, or with up to 8 players in local split-screen.

releases.name: Overtime : Development Hell
releases.summary: Play as Frank, a developer at a highly secretive game development studio rushing to finish the studio's most anticipated release, while being disrupted by an obsessed fan trying to gain information on the long awaited game. Survive Frank's final night alone in this Psychological Horror experience.

releases.name: Mod Complex
releases.summary: A turn-based roguelite about moderating unhinged group chats. Read every message, then approve, delete, timeout or ban before the hour ends. Build streaks, install bots and survive seven servers without getting reported to the FBI.

releases.name: Fairy Keykeepers: Tidy Up Together
releases.summary: Fly through a huge workshop as a tiny fairy and sort 3,200 keys by colour, head and shape. Play solo or in a group of up to 4, learn useful magic, restore the workshop, collect picture pieces and spoil the resident cat.
